game_title: Off By One Fixer – Glowing Heartwood Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood, the glowing ancient tree: the forest ranger must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood: the glowing ancient tree
core_gameplay_loop: In Glowing Heartwood, repeat each round: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the fixes value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the spirit shrine using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The spirit shrine reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the spirit shrine is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Off By One Fixer
